card.name: The word of in time of year
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "time" (or "most") when "year" is expected next, as in "this time of year". Seen mostly in weather and season descriptions.

modes.label: Time of year
modes.description: "of" after "time" in phrases about the season, where "year" comes next.
modes.example: Days are crisp and nights chilly during this time<< of>> year.

modes.description: "of" after "time(s)" in dosing text, where another time word like "day" follows.

card.writes: It promotes "year" and suppresses "month" and "week", so it pushes the next word toward year.
card.plain: It fires on the "of" in "time of year" and helps the model predict that "year" comes next.
